stories.title: 🕊️ Ésaïe 40
summaryBullets: "Comfort, comfort My people," says your God (40:1).
"Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and cry to her that her warfare is ended, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received from le SEIGNEUR's hand double for all her sins" (40:2).
On entend une voix crier :« Dégagez un chemin ╵dans le désert ╵pour l’Eternel,nivelez dans la steppeune route pour notre Dieu ! (40:3).
Toute vallée sera élevée,toute montagne abaissée ╵ainsi que toutes les collines.Les lieux accidentés ╵se changeront en plaine,les rochers escarpés ╵deviendront des vallées. (40:4).
Alors la gloire ╵de l’Eternel ╵sera manifestée,et tous les hommes ╵la verront à la fois.L’Eternel l’a promis. » (40:5).
A voice says, "Cry!" And I said, "What shall I cry?" All flesh is grass, and all its beauty is like the flower of the field (40:6).
The grass withers, the flower fades when the breath of le SEIGNEUR blows on it; surely the people are grass (40:7).
The grass withers, the flower fades, but the word of our God will stand forever (40:8).

Go on up to a high mountain, O Zion, herald of good news; lift up your voice with strength, O Jerusalem, herald of good news; lift it up, fear not; say to the cities of Judah, "Behold your God!" (40:9).
Voici l’Eternel, le Seigneur ;il vient avec puissanceet son bras lui assure ╵la souveraineté.Voici : ses récompenses ╵sont avec lui,et le fruit de son œuvre ╵va devant lui. (40:10).
He will tend His flock like a shepherd; He will gather the lambs in His arms; He will carry them in His bosom, and gently lead those that are with young (40:11).

Qui a mesuré l’océan ╵dans le creux de sa main ?Qui a déterminé les dimensions du ciel ╵avec la largeur de sa main ?Qui a tassé dans un boisseau ╵toute la poussière du sol ?Qui a bien pu peser ╵les montagnes sur la basculeet les coteaux sur la balance ? (40:12).
Who has measured the Spirit of le SEIGNEUR, or what man shows Him his counsel? (40:13).
Whom did He consult, and who made Him understand? Who taught Him the path of justice, and taught Him knowledge, and showed Him the way of understanding? (40:14).
Behold, the nations are like a drop from a bucket, and are accounted as the dust on the scales; behold, He takes up the coastlands like fine dust (40:15).
Lebanon would not suffice for fuel, nor are its beasts enough for a holocauste (40:16).
All the nations are as nothing before Him; they are accounted by Him as less than nothing and emptiness (40:17).
To whom then will you liken God, or what likeness compare with Him? (40:18).
An idol! A craftsman casts it, and a goldsmith overlays it with gold and casts for it silver chains (40:19).
He who is too impoverished for an offering chooses wood that will not rot; he seeks out a skillful craftsman to set up an idol that will not move (40:20).
Ne le savez-vous pas ?Ne l’avez-vous pas entendu ?Cela ne vous a-t-il pas été déclaré ╵dès le commencement ?N’avez-vous pas comprisla fondation du monde ? (40:21).
It is He who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them like a tent to dwell in (40:22).
Who brings princes to nothing, and makes the rulers of the earth as emptiness (40:23).

A peine ont-ils été plantés,à peine ont-ils été semés,à peine ont-ils poussé ╵quelque racine en terre,que l’Eternel souffle sur euxet les voilà qui sèchentet qui sont emportés ╵comme un fétu de paille ╵par la tempête. (40:24).
"To whom then will you compare Me, that I should be like him?" says the Holy One (40:25).

Lift up your eyes on high and see: who created these? He who brings out their host by number, calling them all by name; by the greatness of His might and because He is strong in power, not one is missing (40:26).
Why do you say, O Jacob, and speak, O Israel, "My way is hidden from le SEIGNEUR, and my right is disregarded by my God"? (40:27).

Ne le sais-tu donc pas ?Et n’as-tu pas apprisque l’Eternel est Dieu ╵de toute éternité ?C’est lui qui a créé ╵les confins de la terre.Il ne se lasse pas, ╵il ne s’épuise pas,et son intelligence ╵ne peut être sondée. (40:28).
He gives power to the faint, and to him who has no might He increases strength (40:29).
Even youths shall faint and be weary, and young men shall fall exhausted (40:30).
But they who wait for le SEIGNEUR shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings like eagles; they shall run and not be weary; they shall walk and not faint (40:31).

translationNotes.note: Ordre de parler avec tendresse et d'annoncer la fin de la peine (40:1-2).

translationNotes.note: Langage du héraut pour annoncer le règne de Dieu (40:9-10).

translationNotes.note: Image sculptée en contraste avec le Créateur vivant (40:18-20).

stories.keyTakeaway: Dieu annonce la consolation et un nouveau départ ; Sa parole subsiste, les idoles ne sont rien, et Il fortifie ceux qui sont las.

stories.title: ⚖️ Ésaïe 41
summaryBullets: "Listen to Me in silence, O coastlands; let the peoples renew their strength; let them approach, then let them speak; let us together draw near for judgment" (41:1).

"Who stirred up one from the east whom victory meets at every step? He gives up nations before him, so that he tramples kings underfoot; he makes them like dust with his sword, like driven stubble with his bow" (41:2).
"He pursues them and passes on safely, by paths his feet have not trod" (41:3).
"Who has performed and done this, calling the generations from the beginning? I, le SEIGNEUR, the first, and with the last; I am He" (41:4).
The coastlands have seen and are afraid; the ends of the earth tremble; they have drawn near and come (41:5).
Everyone helps his neighbor and says to his brother, "Be strong!" (41:6).

The craftsman strengthens the goldsmith, and he who smooths with the hammer him who strikes the anvil, saying of the soldering, "It is good"; and they strengthen it with nails so that it cannot be moved (41:7).
"But you, Israel, My servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham, My friend" (41:8).
toi que je suis allé chercher ╵aux confins de la terreet que j’ai appelé ╵de ses extrémités,toi à qui j’avais dit :« Tu es mon serviteur »,je t’ai choisiet non pas rejeté. (41:9).
"Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with My righteous right hand" (41:10).
Tous ceux qui sont irrités contre toi,sombreront dans la honte ╵et dans le déshonneur.Tes adversaires ╵seront réduits à rien, ╵ils périront. (41:11).
Tu auras beau chercher, ╵tu ne trouveras plusceux qui te querellaient.Ils seront tous anéantis, ╵réduits à rienceux qui t’ont fait la guerre. (41:12).
"For I, le SEIGNEUR your God, hold your right hand; it is I who say to you, 'Fear not, I am the one who helps you'" (41:13).
"Fear not, you worm Jacob, you men of Israel! I am the one who helps you," declares le SEIGNEUR; "your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel" (41:14).
Voici je fais de toiun traîneau de battage ╵tout neuf,armé de pointes,tu battras les montagnes, ╵tu les broieras,tu rendras les collines ╵semblables à la paille. (41:15).
Oui, tu les vanneras,et le vent les emportera,l’ouragan les dispersera.Mais toi, tu placeras ta joie ╵en l’Eternel,et ta fierté ╵dans le Saint d’Israël. (41:16).
"When the poor and needy seek water and there is none, and their tongue is parched with thirst, I le SEIGNEUR will answer them; I the God of Israel will not forsake them" (41:17).

Je ferai sourdre des rivières ╵du sommet des montagneset je ferai jaillir des sources ╵au milieu des vallées,je transformerai le désert ╵en étang rempli d’eauet le pays aride ╵en sources jaillissantes. (41:18).
Je planterai dans le désert ╵le cèdre et l’acacia,le myrte et l’olivier.Je ferai croître dans la steppele cyprès, le pin et le buis, (41:19).
"That they may see and know, may consider and understand together, that the hand of le SEIGNEUR has done this, the Holy One of Israel has created it" (41:20).
"Set forth your case," says le SEIGNEUR; "bring your proofs," says the King of Jacob (41:21).
"Let them bring them and tell us what is to happen. Tell us the former things, what they are, that we may consider them, that we may know their outcome; or declare to us the things to come" (41:22).
"Tell us what is to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods; do good, or do harm, that we may be dismayed and terrified" (41:23).
"Behold, you are nothing, and your work is less than nothing; an abomination is he who chooses you" (41:24).
Du nord, je fais surgir un homme,il va venir, ╵oui, du soleil levant,il est appelé par son nom,il piétine les gouverneurs ╵comme s’ils étaient de la boue,comme un potier foule l’argile. (41:25).

Qui a prédit cela ╵dès le commencementpour que nous le sachions ?Qui donc l’a annoncé ╵bien longtemps à l’avanceafin que nous disions : « C’est juste ? »Non, personne ne l’a prédit,personne n’a rien annoncéet personne n’a entendu ╵des paroles venant de vous. (41:26).
"I was the first to say to Zion, 'Behold, here they are!' and I give to Jerusalem a herald of good news" (41:27).
"But when I look, there is no one; among these there is no counselor who, when I ask, gives an answer" (41:28).
"Behold, they are all a delusion; their works are nothing; their metal images are empty wind" (41:29).
crossRefs: Matthieu 12:18-21 — La description du Serviteur citée.

translationNotes.note: Raccourci pour les peuples lointains convoqués à écouter (41:1-5).

stories.title: ⚖️ Ésaïe 42
summaryBullets: "Behold My servant, whom I uphold, My chosen, in whom My soul delights; I have put My Spirit upon him; he will bring forth justice to the nations" (42:1).
"He will not cry aloud or lift up his voice, or make it heard in the street" (42:2).
"A bruised reed he will not break, and a faintly burning wick he will not quench; he will faithfully bring forth justice" (42:3).
Il ne faiblira pas,et il ne ploiera pasjusqu’à ce qu’il ait établi ╵le droit sur terre,jusqu’à ce que les îles ╵et les régions côtières ╵mettent leur espoir en sa loi. (42:4).

Thus says God, le SEIGNEUR, who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and what comes from it, who gives breath to the people on it and spirit to those who walk in it (42:5).

Moi, l’Eternel, ╵moi, je t’ai appelé ╵dans un juste desseinet je te tiendrai par la main ;je te protégerai ╵et je t’établiraipour conclure une alliance avec le peuple,pour être la lumière des peuples étrangers, (42:6).
pour ouvrir les yeux des aveugles,pour tirer du cachot ╵les prisonniers,de la maison d’arrêt ╵ceux qui habitent les ténèbres. (42:7).
"Je suis le SEIGNEUR; that is My name; My glory I give to no other, nor My praise to carved idols" (42:8).
"Behold, the former things have come to pass, and new things I now declare; before they spring forth I tell you of them" (42:9).

Chantez à l’Eternel ╵un cantique nouveau,entonnez sa louange ╵aux confins de la terre,vous qui voguez sur mer,et vous qui la peuplez,vous les îles ╵et les régions côtières, ╵vous qui les habitez ! (42:10).
Désert et villes du désert,campements de Qédar, ╵élevez votre voix !Habitants de Séla, ╵exultez d’allégresse !Du sommet des montagnes, ╵poussez des cris de joie, (42:11).
Let them give glory to le SEIGNEUR and declare His praise in the coastlands (42:12).
The LORD goes out like a mighty man, like a man of war He stirs up His zeal; He cries out, He shouts aloud, He shows Himself mighty against His foes (42:13).
"For a long time I have held My peace; I have kept still and restrained Myself; now I will cry out like a woman in labor; I will gasp and pant" (42:14).
"I will lay waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their vegetation; I will turn the rivers into islands, and dry up the pools" (42:15).

"And I will lead the blind in a way that they do not know, in paths that they have not known I will guide them. I will turn the darkness before them into light, the rough places into level ground. These are the things I do, and I do not forsake them" (42:16).
They are turned back and utterly put to shame, who trust in carved idols, who say to metal images, "You are our gods" (42:17).
"Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see!" (42:18).
"Who is blind but My servant, or deaf as My messenger whom I send? Who is blind as My dedicated one, or blind as the servant of le SEIGNEUR?" (42:19).
"He sees many things, but does not observe them; his ears are open, but he does not hear" (42:20).
The LORD was pleased, for His righteousness' sake, to magnify His law and make it glorious (42:21).
But this is a people plundered and looted; they are all of them trapped in holes and hidden in prisons; they have become plunder with none to rescue, spoil with none to say, "Restore!" (42:22).
Who among you will give ear to this, will attend and listen for the time to come? (42:23).

Qui a livré Jacob ╵à ceux qui le dépouillent ?Qui livra Israël ╵à ceux qui l’ont pillé ?N’est-ce pas l’Eternel,envers qui nous avons péché,et dont nous avons refusé ╵de suivre les sentiers ╵qu’il nous avait prescrits ?Oui, ils n’ont pas ╵obéi à sa Loi. (42:24).
So He poured on him the heat of His anger and the might of battle; it set him on fire all around, but he did not understand; it burned him up, but he did not take it to heart (42:25).

stories.title: 🎶 Ésaïe 43
summaryBullets: But now thus says le SEIGNEUR, He who created you, O Jacob, He who formed you, O Israel: "Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are Mine" (43:1).

Quand tu passeras par les eaux,je serai avec toi,quand tu traverseras les fleuves,ils ne te submergeront pas,quand tu marcheras dans le feu,il ne te fera pas de malet par les flammes tu ne seras pas brûlé, (43:2).
"For Je suis le SEIGNEUR votre Dieu, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I give Egypt as your ransom, Cush and Seba in exchange for you" (43:3).
"Because you are precious in My eyes, and honored, and I love you, I give men in return for you, peoples in exchange for your life" (43:4).
Sois donc sans crainte,car je suis avec toi,je ferai revenir ╵tes enfants de l’orientje te rassemblerai ╵de l’occident. (43:5).
Je dirai au septentrion : ╵« Rends-les ! »Et au midi : ╵« Ne les retiens donc pas !Fais revenir mes fils ╵des pays éloignés,fais revenir mes filles ╵des confins de la terre, (43:6).
"Everyone who is called by My name, whom I created for My glory, whom I formed and made" (43:7).
"Bring out the people who are blind, yet have eyes, who are deaf, yet have ears!" (43:8).

"All the nations gather together, and the peoples assemble. Who among them can declare this, and show us the former things? Let them bring their witnesses to prove them right, and let them hear and say, 'It is true'" (43:9).

"You are My witnesses," declares le SEIGNEUR, "and My servant whom I have chosen, that you may know and believe Me and understand that I am He. Before Me no god was formed, nor shall there be any after Me" (43:10).
"I, Je suis le SEIGNEUR, and besides Me there is no savior" (43:11).
"I declared and saved and proclaimed, when there was no strange god among you; and you are My witnesses," declares le SEIGNEUR, "and I am God" (43:12).
"Also henceforth I am He; there is none who can deliver from My hand; I work, and who can turn it back?" (43:13).
Thus says le SEIGNEUR, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "For your sake I send to Babylon and bring them all down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they rejoice" (43:14).
"Je suis le SEIGNEUR, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King" (43:15).
Ainsi dit l’Eternel,qui, à travers la mer, ╵a ouvert un cheminet, dans les grosses eaux, ╵a frayé un sentier, (43:16).
Who brings forth chariot and horse, army and warrior; they lie down, they cannot rise, they are extinguished, quenched like a wick (43:17).
"Remember not the former things, nor consider the things of old" (43:18).
je vais réaliser ╵une chose nouvelle,elle germe dès à présent,ne la reconnaîtrez-vous pas ?J’ouvrirai un chemin ╵à travers le désertet je ferai jaillir ╵des fleuves dans la steppe ; (43:19).

les animaux sauvages,les chacals, les autruches, ╵célébreront ma gloire,car je ferai jaillir ╵de l’eau dans le désert,des fleuves dans la steppe,pour abreuver mon peuple, ╵celui que j’ai élu. (43:20).
"The people whom I formed for Myself that they might declare My praise" (43:21).
"Yet you did not call upon Me, O Jacob; but you have been weary of Me, O Israel!" (43:22).
"You have not brought Me your sheep for holocaustes, or honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, or wearied you with frankincense" (43:23).
"You have not bought Me sweet cane with money, or satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities" (43:24).
"I, I am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake, and I will not remember your sins" (43:25).
"Put Me in remembrance; let us argue together; set forth your case, that you may be proved right" (43:26).
"Your first father sinned, and your mediators transgressed against Me" (43:27).
"Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary, and deliver Jacob to utter destruction and Israel to reviling" (43:28).
crossRefs: Apocalypse 15:3 — Chant célébrant les œuvres de Dieu (motif du chant nouveau).
2 Corinthiens 1:10 — Dieu qui délivre (thème du salut).
Exode 14:21-22 — Chemin à travers la mer (arrière-plan de l'exode).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: גָּאַל (gaʾal) — Greek (LXX): λυτρόομαι — Aramaic: פָּרַק/גאל
translationNotes.note: Langage de rachat familial/juridique ; Dieu revendique Israël comme Sien (43:1).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: עֵדִים (ʿedim) — Greek (LXX): μάρτυρες — Aramaic: סַהֲדִין
translationNotes.note: Israël est désigné pour témoigner que l'Éternel seul est Dieu (43:10-12).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: חֲדָשָׁה (ḥadashah) — Greek (LXX): καινόν — Aramaic: חדתא
translationNotes.note: Nouvel acte de salut, comme un second exode (43:19).

stories.keyTakeaway: Dieu promet le secours à Son peuple aveugle et pillé, les déclare Ses témoins, et annonce un nouvel exode à travers le désert et les eaux.

stories.title: 🪵 Ésaïe 44
summaryBullets: "But now hear, O Jacob My servant, Israel whom I have chosen!" (44:1).
Thus says le SEIGNEUR who made you, who formed you from the womb and will help you: "Fear not, O Jacob My servant, Jeshurun whom I have chosen" (44:2).
"For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and streams on the dry ground; I will pour My Spirit upon your offspring, and My blessing on your descendants" (44:3).
"They shall spring up among the grass like willows by flowing streams" (44:4).
"This one will say, 'Je suis le SEIGNEUR's,' another will call on the name of Jacob, and another will write on his hand, 'The LORD's,' and name himself by the name of Israel" (44:5).
Thus says le SEIGNEUR, the King of Israel and his Redeemer, le SEIGNEUR of hosts: "I am the first and I am the last; besides Me there is no god" (44:6).
"Who is like Me? Let him proclaim it. Let him declare and set it before Me, since I appointed an ancient people. Let them declare what is to come, and what will happen" (44:7).
"Fear not, nor be afraid; have I not told you from of old and declared it? And you are My witnesses! Is there a God besides Me? There is no Rock; I know not any" (44:8).
All who fashion idols are nothing, and the things they delight in do not profit. Their witnesses neither see nor know, that they may be put to shame (44:9).
Who fashions a god or casts an idol that is profitable for nothing? (44:10).

Voici : tous leurs fidèles ╵seront couverts de honte,car ceux qui les ont fabriqués ╵ne sont que des humains !Qu’ils se rassemblent touset qu’ils se tiennent là !Ils seront effrayés ╵et confus tous ensemble. (44:11).

The ironsmith takes a cutting tool and works it over the coals. He fashions it with hammers and works it with his strong arm. He becomes hungry, and his strength fails; he drinks no water and is faint (44:12).

The carpenter stretches a line; he marks it out with a pencil. He shapes it with planes and marks it with a compass. He shapes it into the figure of a man, with the beauty of a man, to dwell in a house (44:13).

Il a coupé des cèdres,ou bien il s’est choisi ╵du cyprès ou du chênequ’il a laissé ╵devenir bien robusteparmi les arbres des forêts,ou bien il prend un pin ╵qu’il a planté lui-même,que la pluie a fait croître. (44:14).
Then it becomes fuel for a man. He takes a part of it and warms himself; he kindles a fire and bakes bread. Also he makes a god and worships it; he makes it an idol and falls down before it (44:15).
Et maintenant, écoute, ╵Jacob, mon serviteur, (44:16).
And the rest of it he makes into a god, his idol, and falls down to it and worships it. He prays to it and says, "Deliver me, for you are my god!" (44:17).
They know not, nor do they discern, for He has shut their eyes, so that they cannot see, and their hearts, so that they cannot understand (44:18).

Aucun ne réfléchit,aucun n’a de savoirni assez de raison ╵pour se dire en lui-même :« J’ai brûlé la moitié ╵de mon bois dans le feu,j’ai aussi cuit du pain ╵sur les braises du bois,j’ai rôti de la viande ╵dont je me suis nourri,et de ce qui restait, ╵j’ai fait une abomination,je me suis prosterné ╵devant un bout de bois ! » (44:19).
He feeds on ashes; a deluded heart has led him astray, and he cannot deliver himself or say, "Is there not a lie in my right hand?" (44:20).
"Remember these things, O Jacob, and Israel, for you are My servant; I formed you; you are My servant; O Israel, you will not be forgotten by Me" (44:21).
"I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud and your sins like mist; return to Me, for I have redeemed you" (44:22).

Sing, O heavens, for le SEIGNEUR has done it; shout, O depths of the earth; break forth into singing, O mountains, O forest, and every tree in it! For le SEIGNEUR has redeemed Jacob, and will be glorified in Israel (44:23).
Thus says le SEIGNEUR, your Redeemer, who formed you from the womb: "Je suis le SEIGNEUR, who made all things, who alone stretched out the heavens, who spread out the earth by Myself" (44:24).
"Who frustrates the signs of liars and makes fools of diviners, who turns wise men back and makes their knowledge foolish" (44:25).

J’accomplis la parole ╵prononcée par mon serviteuret je fais réussir les plans ╵annoncés par mes messagers.C’est moi, moi qui ai dit ╵au sujet de Jérusalem :« Qu’elle soit habitée ! »et concernant les villes de Juda :« Qu’elles soient rebâties ! »Oui, j’en relèverai les ruines. (44:26).
"Who says to the deep, 'Be dry; I will dry up your rivers'" (44:27).
Et je dis de Cyrus : ╵« C’est mon berger,et il accomplira ╵tout ce que je désire. »Il dira de Jérusalem :« Qu’elle soit rebâtie »,et il dira du Temple :« Posez ses fondations ! » (44:28).
crossRefs: Deutéronome 6:4 — L'Éternel est un (revendication exclusive).
Jean 7:37-39 — L'eau vive et l'Esprit.

translationNotes.note: Effacer le registre des péchés (43:25).

translationNotes.term: Je suis le premier et le dernier

translationNotes.note: Titre de souveraineté unique (44:6).

stories.title: 🪙 Ésaïe 45
summaryBullets: Thus says le SEIGNEUR to His anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have grasped, to subdue nations before him and to loose the belts of kings, to open doors before him that gates may not be closed (45:1).
"I will go before you and level the exalted places, I will break in pieces the doors of bronze and cut through the bars of iron" (45:2).
"I will give you the treasures of darkness and the hoards in secret places, that you may know that it is I, le SEIGNEUR, the God of Israel, who call you by your name" (45:3).
"For the sake of My servant Jacob, and Israel My chosen, I call you by your name, I name you, though you do not know Me" (45:4).
"Je suis le SEIGNEUR, and there is no other, besides Me there is no God; I equip you, though you do not know Me" (45:5).
afin que du soleil levant ╵jusqu’au soleil couchant, ╵tout homme sachequ’en dehors de moi, ╵il n’y a que néant,que je suis l’Eternelet qu’il n’y en a aucun autre. (45:6).
"I form light and create darkness; I make well-being and create calamity; Je suis le SEIGNEUR, who does all these things" (45:7).

"Shower, O heavens, from above, and let the clouds rain down righteousness; let the earth open, that salvation and righteousness may bear fruit; let the earth cause them both to sprout; I le SEIGNEUR have created it" (45:8).
"Woe to him who strives with Him who formed him, a pot among earthen pots! Does the clay say to him who forms it, 'What are you making?' or 'Your work has no handles'?" (45:9).
"Woe to him who says to a father, 'What are you begetting?' or to a woman, 'With what are you in labor?'" (45:10).

Ainsi dit l’Eternel, ╵lui le Saint d’Israël,lui qui l’a façonné :Oserez-vous me questionner ╵sur ce qui doit venir,ou me donnerez-vous des ordres ╵au sujet de mes fils ╵et au sujet de l’œuvre ╵que mes mains ont réalisée ? (45:11).
"I made the earth and created man on it; it was My hands that stretched out the heavens, and I commanded all their host" (45:12).
"I have stirred him up in righteousness, and I will make all his ways level; he shall build My city and set My exiles free, not for price or reward," says le SEIGNEUR of hosts (45:13).

Ainsi dit l’Eternel :Les profits de l’Egypte, ╵les gains de l’Ethiopieet des gens de Seba, ╵si hauts de taille,tout cela passera chez toi, ╵cela t’appartiendra.Ces peuples viendront à ta suiteen marchant enchaînéset ils se prosterneront devant toien te disant ╵sur un ton suppliant :« C’est chez toi seulement ╵que l’on peut trouver Dieu,et en dehors de lui, ╵il n’y en a pas d’autre,car tous les autres dieux ╵ne sont que du néant. » (45:14).
"Truly, You are a God who hides Himself, O God of Israel, the Savior" (45:15).
All of them are put to shame and confounded; the makers of idols go in confusion together (45:16).
But Israel is saved by le SEIGNEUR with everlasting salvation; you shall not be put to shame or confounded to all eternity (45:17).

For thus says le SEIGNEUR, who created the heavens (He is God!), who formed the earth and made it (He established it; He did not create it empty, He formed it to be inhabited!): "Je suis le SEIGNEUR, and there is no other" (45:18).
"I did not speak in secret, in a land of darkness; I did not say to the offspring of Jacob, 'Seek Me in vain.' I le SEIGNEUR speak the truth; I declare what is right" (45:19).
"Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, you survivors of the nations! They have no knowledge who carry about their wooden idols, and keep on praying to a god that cannot save" (45:20).

"Declare and present your case; let them take counsel together! Who told this long ago? Who declared it of old? Was it not I, le SEIGNEUR? And there is no other god besides Me, a righteous God and a Savior; there is none besides Me" (45:21).
"Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no other" (45:22).
"By Myself I have sworn; from My mouth has gone out in righteousness a word that shall not return: 'To Me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear allegiance'" (45:23).
disant à mon sujet :« C’est en l’Eternel seulque résident pour moi ╵la justice et la force. »A lui viendront, honteux,tous ceux qui, contre lui, ╵s’étaient mis en colère. (45:24).
"In le SEIGNEUR all the offspring of Israel shall be justified and shall glory" (45:25).

stories.title: 🪙 Ésaïe 46
summaryBullets: Bel bows down; Nebo stoops; their idols are on beasts and livestock; these things you carry are borne as burdens on weary beasts (46:1).
They stoop; they bow down together; they cannot save the burden, but themselves go into captivity (46:2).
Ecoutez-moi, ╵gens de Jacob,vous tous qui subsistez ╵du peuple d’Israël,vous que j’ai pris en charge ╵dès avant la naissance,que j’ai portés ╵dès le sein maternel : (46:3).
"Even to your old age I am He, and to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear; I will carry and will save" (46:4).
"To whom will you liken Me and make Me equal, and compare Me, that we may be alike?" (46:5).
Ils prennent tout l’or de leur bourse,ils pèsent l’argent au fléauet ils paient un orfèvrepour qu’il en fasse un dieudevant lequel ils puissent ╵se prosterneret l’adorer. (46:6).

They lift it to their shoulders, they carry it, they set it in its place, and it stands there; it cannot move from its place. If one cries to it, it does not answer or save him from his trouble (46:7).
"Remember this and stand firm, recall it to mind, you transgressors" (46:8).
"Remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like Me" (46:9).
"Declaring the end from the beginning and from ancient times things not yet done, saying, 'My counsel shall stand, and I will accomplish all My purpose'" (46:10).
"Calling a bird of prey from the east, the man of My counsel from a far country. I have spoken, and I will bring it to pass; I have purposed, and I will do it" (46:11).
"Listen to Me, you stubborn of heart, you who are far from righteousness" (46:12).
"I bring near My righteousness; it is not far off, and My salvation will not delay; I will put salvation in Zion, for Israel My glory" (46:13).

stories.title: 🪙 Ésaïe 47
summaryBullets: Va, descends de ton trône (47:1).
Take the millstones and grind flour, put off your veil, strip off your robe, uncover your legs, pass through the rivers (47:2).
Ainsi ta nudité ╵sera vue au grand jouret ton opprobre apparaîtra.Je vais exercer ma rétributionet je n’épargnerai personne. (47:3).
Our Redeemer—le SEIGNEUR of hosts is His name—is the Holy One of Israel (47:4).
Assieds-toi en silence,entre dans les ténèbres,Dame des Chaldéens,car on ne t’appellera plusla reine des royaumes. (47:5).
"I was angry with My people; I profaned My heritage; I gave them into your hand; you showed them no mercy; on the aged you made your yoke exceedingly heavy" (47:6).
"You said, 'I shall be mistress forever,' so that you did not lay these things to heart or remember their end" (47:7).
"Now therefore hear this, you lover of pleasures, who sit securely, who say in your heart, 'I am, and there is no one besides me; I shall not sit as a widow or know the loss of children'" (47:8).

"These two things shall come to you in a moment, in one day; the loss of children and widowhood shall come upon you in full measure, in spite of your many sorceries and the great power of your enchantments" (47:9).
"You felt secure in your wickedness; you said, 'No one sees me'; your wisdom and your knowledge led you astray, and you said in your heart, 'I am, and there is no one besides me'" (47:10).

"But evil shall come upon you, which you will not know how to charm away; disaster shall fall upon you, for which you will not be able to atone; and ruin shall come upon you suddenly, of which you know nothing" (47:11).
"Stand fast in your enchantments and your many sorceries, with which you have labored from your youth; perhaps you may be able to succeed; perhaps you may inspire terror" (47:12).
"You are wearied with your many counsels; let them stand forth and save you, those who divide the heavens, who gaze at the stars, who at the new moons make known what shall come upon you" (47:13).

Les voilà devenus ╵tous comme de la paille ╵que consume le feu.Non, ils ne pourront pas ╵sauver leur vie des flammes,ce ne sera pas une braise ╵que l’on allume pour se réchauffer,ni un feu devant lequel on s’assoit. (47:14).
"Such to you are those with whom you have labored, who have done business with you from your youth; they wander about, each in his own direction; there is no one to save you" (47:15).

stories.title: 🪙 Ésaïe 48
summaryBullets: "Hear this, O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and who came from the waters of Judah, who swear by the name of le SEIGNEUR and confess the God of Israel, but not in truth or right" (48:1).
"For they call themselves after the holy city, and stay themselves on the God of Israel; le SEIGNEUR of hosts is His name" (48:2).
"The former things I declared of old; they went out from My mouth, and I announced them; then suddenly I did them, and they came to pass" (48:3).
"Because I know that you are obstinate, and your neck is an iron sinew and your forehead brass" (48:4).
"I declared them to you from of old, before they came to pass I announced them to you, lest you should say, 'My idol did them, my carved image and my metal image commanded them'" (48:5).
"You have heard; now see all this; and will you not declare it? From this time forth I announce to you new things, hidden things that you have not known" (48:6).
"They are created now, not long ago; before today you have never heard of them, lest you should say, 'Behold, I knew them'" (48:7).
"You have never heard, you have never known, from of old your ear has not been opened. For I knew that you would surely deal treacherously, and that from before birth you were called a rebel" (48:8).
"For My name's sake I defer My anger; for the sake of My praise I restrain it for you, that I may not cut you off" (48:9).
"Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tried you in the furnace of affliction" (48:10).
"For My own sake, for My own sake, I do it, for how should My name be profaned? My glory I will not give to another" (48:11).
"Listen to Me, O Jacob, and Israel, whom I called! I am He; I am the first, and I am the last" (48:12).
"My hand laid the foundation of the earth, and My right hand spread out the heavens; when I call to them, they stand forth together" (48:13).

Vous tous, rassemblez-vous ╵et écoutez-moi bien !Qui donc parmi les autres dieux ╵a annoncé ces choses ?Cet homme que l’Eternel aimeaccomplira ce qu’il désire ╵à l’encontre de Babylone,son bras se lèvera ╵contre les Chaldéens. (48:14).
"I, even I, have spoken and called him; I have brought him, and he will prosper in his way" (48:15).
Approchez-vous de moi, ╵écoutez bien ceci :Dès le commencement ╵je n’ai jamais parlé ╵dans le secret.Quand les événements ╵se sont produits, ╵j’étais présent. (48:16).
Thus says le SEIGNEUR, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "Je suis le SEIGNEUR votre Dieu, who teaches you to profit, who leads you in the way you should go" (48:17).
"Oh that you had paid attention to My commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea" (48:18).
"Your offspring would have been like the sand, and your descendants like its grains; their name would never be cut off or destroyed from before Me" (48:19).

Sortez de Babylone !Fuyez les Chaldéens !Avec des cris de joie,publiez la nouvelle ! ╵Proclamez-la,répandez-la au loin, ╵jusqu’au bout de la terre !Dites que l’Eternel a délivré ╵son serviteur Jacob. (48:20).
Quand il les a conduits ╵à travers le désert,ils n’ont pas souffert de la soifcar il a fait couler ╵pour eux l’eau du rocher ;il a fendu le roc,et les eaux ont jailli. (48:21).
"There is no peace," says le SEIGNEUR, "for the wicked" (48:22).

stories.title: 🕯️ Ésaïe 49
summaryBullets: Vous tous qui habitez les îles ╵et les régions côtières, ╵écoutez-moi ! (49:1).
He made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of His hand He hid me; He made me a polished arrow; in His quiver He hid me away (49:2).
And He said to me, "You are My servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified" (49:3).
But I said, "I have labored in vain; I have spent my strength for nothing and vanity; yet surely my right is with le SEIGNEUR, and my recompense with my God" (49:4).

Et maintenant, voici ╵ce que dit l’Eternel,celui qui m’a formé ╵dès le sein de ma mèrepour que je sois son serviteur,pour ramener Jacob à luiet pour rassembler Israël ╵auprès de lui.Je serai honoré ╵aux yeux de l’Eternelet mon Dieu est la source de ma force. (49:5).

Et il a dit aussi : ╵« Tu ne seras pas seulement ╵mon serviteurpour rétablir ╵les tribus de Jacobet ramener ceux que j’ai préservés ╵du peuple d’Israël.Car je t’établirai ╵pour être la lumière ╵des autres peuplesafin que mon salut parvienne ╵aux extrémités de la terre. » (49:6).

Thus says le SEIGNEUR, the Redeemer of Israel and his Holy One, to one deeply despised, abhorred by the nation, the servant of rulers: "Kings shall see and arise; princes, and they shall prostrate themselves; because of le SEIGNEUR, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you" (49:7).

Voici ce que dit l’Eternel :Au moment favorable ╵je répondrai à ton appel,et au jour du salut ╵je viendrai à ton aide.Je te protégerai, ╵et je t’établiraipour conclure une alliance avec le peupleet pour relever le pays,pour faire le partage ╵des patrimoines dévastés, (49:8).

pour dire aux prisonniers : « Sortez »,et à ceux qui demeurent ╵dans les ténèbres :« Montrez-vous ! »Et ils se nourriront ╵partout le long des routes ;ils trouveront des pâturages ╵sur toutes les collines. (49:9).
They shall not hunger or thirst, neither scorching wind nor sun shall strike them, for He who has pity on them will lead them, and by springs of water will guide them (49:10).
And I will make all My mountains a road, and My highways shall be raised up (49:11).
Les voici, ils arrivent ╵des pays éloignés,les uns viennent du nord, ╵les autres du couchant,d’autres encore ╵de la région d’Assouan. (49:12).
Sing for joy, O heavens, and exult, O earth; break forth, O mountains, into singing! For le SEIGNEUR has comforted His people and will have compassion on His afflicted (49:13).
But Zion said, "The LORD has forsaken me; my Lord has forgotten me" (49:14).
"Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should have no compassion on fils de her womb? Even these may forget, yet I will not forget you" (49:15).
"Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of My hands; your walls are continually before Me" (49:16).
Your builders make haste; your destroyers and those who laid you waste go out from you (49:17).

Porte les yeux autour de toi, ╵regarde :ils se rassemblent tous,et ils viennent vers toi.Aussi vrai que je suis vivant,déclare l’Eternel,tu t’en revêtiras ╵comme d’une parure,et tu te les attacheras ╵comme la mariée sa ceinture. (49:18).
"Surely your waste and your desolate places and your devastated land—surely now you will be too narrow for your inhabitants, and those who swallowed you up will be far away" (49:19).
The children born in the time of your bereavement will yet say in your ears: "The place is too narrow for me; make room for me to dwell in" (49:20).
Then you will say in your heart: "Who has borne me these? I was bereaved and barren, exiled and put away, but who has brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; from where have these come?" (49:21).

Voici ce que déclare ╵le Seigneur, l’Eternel :Je ferai signe de la main ╵aux nations étrangères,je dresserai mon étendard ╵en direction des peuples,ils amèneront tes fils dans leurs bras,ils chargeront tes filles ╵sur leurs épaules. (49:22).

Des rois s’occuperont de toi ╵comme s’ils étaient tes parents,et leurs princesses ╵seront tes mères nourricières.Ils se prosterneront ╵devant toi jusqu’à terreet ils lécheront la poussière ╵attachée à tes pieds.Et tu sauras alors ╵que je suis l’Eternelet qu’on n’est pas déçu ╵quand on compte sur moi. (49:23).
"Can the prey be taken from the mighty, or the captives of a tyrant be rescued?" (49:24).

Voici ce que dit l’Eternel :Les captifs du guerrier ╵lui seront enlevés,et la proie du tyran ╵va être délivrée.Je ferai un procès moi-même ╵à ceux qui t’ont fait un procèset je délivrerai ╵moi-même tes enfants. (49:25).

"I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh, and they shall be drunk with their own blood as with wine. Then all flesh shall know that Je suis le SEIGNEUR your Savior, and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob" (49:26).

translationNotes.note: Image de souvenir permanent (49:16).

translationNotes.note: Résolution ferme face aux mauvais traitements (50:7).

stories.title: 🕯️ Ésaïe 50
summaryBullets: Thus says le SEIGNEUR: "Where is your mother's certificate of divorce, with which I sent her away? Or which of My creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities you were sold, and for your transgressions your mother was sent away" (50:1).

"Why, when I came, was there no man; why, when I called, was there no one to answer? Is My hand shortened, that it cannot redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Behold, by My rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a desert" (50:2).
"I clothe the heavens with blackness and make sackcloth their covering" (50:3).

The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with a word him who is weary. Morning by morning He awakens; He awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught (50:4).
The Lord GOD has opened my ear, and I was not rebellious; I turned not backward (50:5).
I gave my back to those who strike, and my cheeks to those who pull out the beard; I hid not my face from disgrace and spitting (50:6).
But the Lord GOD helps me; therefore I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be put to shame (50:7).
He who vindicates me is near. Who will contend with me? Let us stand up together. Who is my adversary? Let him come near to me (50:8).
Behold, the Lord GOD helps me; who will declare me guilty? Behold, all of them will wear out like a garment; the moth will eat them up (50:9).
Who among you fears le SEIGNEUR and obeys the voice of His servant? Let him who walks in darkness and has no light trust in the name of le SEIGNEUR and rely on his God (50:10).

Behold, all you who kindle a fire, who equip yourselves with burning torches! Walk by the light of your fire, and by the torches that you have kindled! This you will have from My hand: you shall lie down in torment (50:11).

stories.title: 🛤️ Ésaïe 51
summaryBullets: Ecoutez-moi, (51:1).
"Look to Abraham your father and to Sarah who bore you; for he was but one when I called him, that I might bless him and multiply him" (51:2).

"For le SEIGNEUR comforts Zion; He comforts all her waste places and makes her wilderness like Eden, her desert like the garden of le SEIGNEUR; joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and the voice of song" (51:3).
"Give attention to Me, My people, and give ear to Me, My nation; for a law will go out from Me, and I will set My justice for a light to the peoples" (51:4).
"My righteousness draws near, My salvation has gone out, and My arms will judge the peoples; the coastlands hope for Me, and for My arm they wait" (51:5).

Levez les yeux au ciel,baissez-les sur la terre,car, comme une fumée, ╵le ciel s’évanouiraet, comme un vêtement, ╵la terre s’usera.Ses habitants mourront ╵comme des mouches,mais mon salut ╵sera établi pour toujours,mon œuvre de justice ╵ne sera pas anéantie. (51:6).
"Listen to Me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is My law; fear not the reproach of man, nor be dismayed at their revilings" (51:7).

Car ils seront ╵mangés par la vermine ╵comme un habit,et rongés par les mites ╵comme la laine.Quant à mon œuvre de justice, ╵elle sera établie pour toujourset mon salut ╵pour toutes les générations. (51:8).
"Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of le SEIGNEUR; awake, as in days of old, the generations of long ago. Was it not You who cut Rahab in pieces, who pierced the dragon?" (51:9).
N’est-ce pas toi ╵qui desséchas la meret qui taris ╵les eaux du grand abîme ?Toi qui fis un chemin ╵dans les profondeurs de la merpour que ton peuple délivré ╵puisse y passer ? (51:10).

De même, ceux que l’Eternel ╵a libérés retourneront,ils iront à Sion ╵avec des cris de joie.Une joie éternelle ╵couronnera leur tête,la joie et l’allégresse ╵les accompagneront,la tristesse et les plaintes ╵fuiront au loin. (51:11).
"I, I am He who comforts you; who are you that you are afraid of man who dies, of fils de man who is made like grass" (51:12).

As-tu donc oublié ╵l’Eternel qui t’a fait,qui a tendu le ciel ╵et a fondé la terre ?Comment peux-tu trembler ╵sans cesse tout le jourparce que le tyran ╵déchaîne sa fureuret se prépare à te détruire ?Maintenant, où est-elle, ╵la fureur du tyran ? (51:13).
"He who is bowed down shall speedily be released; he shall not die and go down to the pit, neither shall his bread be lacking" (51:14).
"Je suis le SEIGNEUR votre Dieu, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar—le SEIGNEUR of hosts is His name" (51:15).
Oui, j’ai mis mes paroles dans ta bouche,je t’ai couvert ╵de l’ombre de ma main,pour étendre le ciel, ╵et pour fonder la terre,et pour proclamer à Sion : ╵« Tu es mon peuple ! » (51:16).
Réveille-toi, réveille-toi,debout, Jérusalem,toi qui as bu la coupe ╵remplie de la colèreque l’Eternel t’a présentée,oui, toi qui as vidé ╵jusqu’à l’ultime gouttela coupe du vertige. (51:17).
Parmi tous les fils ╵que tu as mis au monde,il n’y en a aucun ╵pour te guider,et parmi tous les fils ╵que tu as élevés,il n’y en a aucun ╵pour te prendre la main ! (51:18).
These two things have happened to you—who will console you?—devastation and destruction, famine and sword; who will comfort you? (51:19).
Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street like an antelope in a net; they are full of the wrath of le SEIGNEUR, the rebuke of your God (51:20).
Therefore hear this, you who are afflicted, who are drunk, but not with wine (51:21).
Thus says your Lord, le SEIGNEUR, your God who pleads the cause of His people: "Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of staggering; the bowl of My wrath you shall drink no more" (51:22).

"And I will put it into the hand of your tormentors, who have said to you, 'Bow down, that we may pass over'; and you have made your back like the ground and like the street for them to pass over" (51:23).
crossRefs: Romains 10:15 — « Qu'ils sont beaux les pieds » cité au sujet de la prédication de l'Évangile.
Nahum 1:15 — Bonne nouvelle sur les montagnes (usage antérieur).
Apocalypse 18:4 — « Sortez du milieu d'elle, mon peuple. »

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: כּוֹס חֵמָה (kos ḥemah) — Greek (LXX): ποτήριον θυμοῦ — Aramaic: כס דְּרוּגְזָא
translationNotes.note: Image de souffrance forcée, ensuite transférée aux oppresseurs (51:17-23).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: מְבַשֵּׂר שָׁלוֹם (mevaser shalom) — Greek (LXX): εὐαγγελιζόμενος εἰρήνην — Aramaic: מבשר שלמא
translationNotes.note: Le héraut annonce la royauté de Dieu (52:7).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: הִבָּרוּ… צְאוּ (hibbaru… tseʾu) — Greek (LXX): ἁγνίσθητε… ἐξέρχεσθε — Aramaic: אִתְדַּכּוּ… פְּקוּ
translationNotes.note: Séparation rituelle et morale en quittant Babylone (52:11).

stories.keyTakeaway: Dieu promet un salut durable, retire la coupe de la colère, proclame la bonne nouvelle de paix et de règne, et ordonne un départ pur de Babylone.

stories.title: 🛤️ Ésaïe 52
summaryBullets: Awake, awake, put on your strength, O Zion; put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city; for there shall no more come into you the uncircumcised and the unclean (52:1).
Shake yourself from the dust and arise; be seated, O Jerusalem; loose the bonds from your neck, O captive daughter of Zion (52:2).
For thus says le SEIGNEUR: "You were sold for nothing, and you shall be redeemed without money" (52:3).
Car voici ce que déclare le Seigneur, l’Eternel : Mon peuple est tout d’abord descendu en Egypte afin d’y séjourner, ensuite l’Assyrien l’a opprimé sans cause. (52:4).

"Now therefore what have I here," declares le SEIGNEUR, "seeing that My people are taken away for nothing? Their rulers wail," declares le SEIGNEUR, "and continually all the day My name is despised" (52:5).
"Therefore My people shall know My name. Therefore in that day they shall know that it is I who speak; here I am" (52:6).
How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news of happiness, who publishes salvation, who says to Zion, "Your God reigns" (52:7).
The voice of your watchmen—they lift up their voice; together they sing for joy; for eye to eye they see the return of le SEIGNEUR to Zion (52:8).
Break forth together into singing, you waste places of Jerusalem, for le SEIGNEUR has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem (52:9).
L’Eternel a manifesté ╵sa puissance et sa saintetéaux yeux de toutes les nations,et tous les confins de la terre ╵verrontla délivrance ╵qu’apporte notre Dieu. (52:10).
Depart, depart, go out from there; touch no unclean thing; go out from the midst of her; purify yourselves, you who bear the vessels of le SEIGNEUR (52:11).
Vous ne sortirez pas ╵en courant à la hâte,vous ne marcherez pas ╵comme des fugitifs,car l’Eternel ╵marchera devant vous,et le Dieu d’Israël ╵fermera votre marche. (52:12).
Voici, mon serviteuragira en toute sagesse,il sera haut placé,très élevé, ╵grandement exalté. (52:13).
Beaucoup ont été horrifiéstellement son visage ╵était défiguréet tant son apparence ╵n’avait plus rien d’humain. (52:14).
So shall he sprinkle many nations. Kings shall shut their mouths because of him, for that which has not been told them they see, and that which they have not heard they understand (52:15).

stories.title: ✝️ Ésaïe 53
summaryBullets: Who has believed what he has heard from us? And to whom has the arm of le SEIGNEUR been revealed? (53:1).
For he grew up before Him like a young plant, and like a root out of dry ground; he had no form or majesty that we should look at him, and no beauty that we should desire him (53:2).

Il était méprisé, ╵abandonné des hommes,un homme de douleurhabitué à la souffrance.Oui, il était semblable ╵à ceux devant lesquels ╵on détourne les yeux.Il était méprisé,et nous n’avons fait de lui aucun cas. (53:3).
Surely he has borne our griefs and carried our sorrows; yet we esteemed him stricken, smitten by God, and afflicted (53:4).

Mais c’est pour nos péchés ╵qu’il a été percé,c’est pour nos fautes ╵qu’il a été brisé.Le châtiment ╵qui nous donne la paix ╵est retombé sur luiet c’est par ses blessures ╵que nous sommes guéris. (53:5).
All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned—every one—to his own way; and le SEIGNEUR has laid on him the iniquity of us all (53:6).
Il était maltraité, ╵et il s’est humilié,il n’a pas dit un mot.Semblable à un agneau ╵mené à l’abattoir,tout comme la brebis muette ╵devant ceux qui la tondent,il n’a pas dit un mot. (53:7).

Il a été arraché à la vie ╵avec violence, ╵suite à un jugement.Et qui, parmi les gens ╵de sa génération, ╵s’est soucié de son sort,lorsqu’on l’a retranchédu pays des vivants ?Il a été frappé à mortà cause des péchés ╵que mon peuple a commis. (53:8).
And they made his grave with the wicked and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, and there was no deceit in his mouth (53:9).

Yet it was the will of le SEIGNEUR to crush him; He has put him to grief; when his soul makes an offering for guilt, he shall see his offspring; he shall prolong his days; the will of le SEIGNEUR shall prosper in his hand (53:10).
Out of the anguish of his soul he shall see and be satisfied; by his knowledge shall the righteous one, My servant, make many to be accounted righteous, and he shall bear their iniquities (53:11).

Therefore I will divide him a portion with the many, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was numbered with the transgressors; yet he bore the sin of many, and makes intercession for the transgressors (53:12).
crossRefs: Actes 8:32-35 — Ésaïe 53 lu et expliqué.
1 Pierre 2:22-25 — « Il n'a commis aucun péché... par ses blessures vous avez été guéris. »
Marc 15:28 — « Compté parmi les transgresseurs. »

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: אָשָׁם (ʾasham) — Greek (LXX): περὶ ἁμαρτίας / πλημμέλειας — Aramaic: אָשָׁם
translationNotes.note: Terme sacrificiel ; sa vie est présentée comme une offrande (53:10).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: מְחֹלָל / מְדֻכָּא (meḥolal / medukkaʾ) — Greek (LXX): τετρώμενος / μεμαλακισμένος — Aramaic: מדקר / מדכא
translationNotes.note: Termes de violence décrivant sa souffrance (53:5).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: יַצְדִּיק צַדִּיק עֲבְדִּי לָרַבִּים — Greek (LXX): δικαιῶσαι δίκαιον εὖ δουλεύσαντα πολλοῖς — Aramaic: יְזַכֵּא צַדִּיק עַבְדִּי לְסַגִּיאִין
translationNotes.note: Imagerie de déclaration juridique (53:11).

stories.keyTakeaway: Le Serviteur souffre innocemment, porte la culpabilité d'un grand nombre, meurt, et pourtant la vie et le succès lui sont promis.

stories.title: 🌧️ Ésaïe 54
summaryBullets: Pousse des cris de joie, ╵toi qui étais stérile, (54:1).
"Enlarge the place of your tent, and let the curtains of your habitations be stretched out; do not hold back; lengthen your cords and strengthen your stakes" (54:2).
car tu te répandras ╵sur ta droite et ta gauche,et ta postérité ╵prendra possession de nationset peuplera des villes ╵devenues solitaires. (54:3).

"Fear not, for you will not be ashamed; be not confounded, for you will not be disgraced; for you will forget the shame of your youth, and the reproach of your widowhood you will remember no more" (54:4).
car celui qui t’a faite ╵c’est ton époux.Il a pour nom : ╵le Seigneur des armées célestes.Celui qui te délivre ╵c’est le Saint d’Israël,celui que l’on appelle : ╵le Dieu du monde entier. (54:5).
"For le SEIGNEUR has called you like a wife deserted and grieved in spirit, like a wife of youth when she is cast off," says your God (54:6).
"For a brief moment I deserted you, but with great compassion I will gather you" (54:7).
"In overflowing anger for a moment I hid My face from you, but with everlasting love I will have compassion on you," says le SEIGNEUR, your Redeemer (54:8).
"This is like the days of Noah to Me: as I swore that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth, so I have sworn that I will not be angry with you, and will not rebuke you" (54:9).

Même si les montagnes ╵se mettaient à partir,même si les collines ╵venaient à chanceler,mon amour envers toi ╵ne partira jamais ;mon alliance de paix ╵ne chancellera pas,déclare l’Eternel, ╵rempli de tendresse pour toi. (54:10).
"O afflicted one, storm-tossed and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in antimony, and lay your foundations with sapphires" (54:11).
"I will make your pinnacles of agate, your gates of carbuncles, and all your wall of precious stones" (54:12).
Tous tes enfants seront ╵instruits par l’Eternelet la paix de tes fils ╵sera très grande. (54:13).
Tu seras affermie ╵par la justice,à l’abri de toute oppression ;tu n’auras rien à craindre,car la terreur sera bannieet elle ne t’atteindra plus. (54:14).
"If anyone stirs up strife, it is not from Me; whoever stirs up strife with you shall fall because of you" (54:15).
"Behold, I have created the smith who blows the fire of coals and produces a weapon for its purpose. I have also created the ravager to destroy" (54:16).

Toute arme fabriquée ╵pour te faire du maln’atteindra pas son but,et tu pourras confondretous tes accusateurs ╵en jugement,car tel est l’apanage ╵des serviteurs de l’Eternelet c’est ainsi ╵que je leur fais justice,l’Eternel le déclare. (54:17).
crossRefs: Jean 7:37 — « Si quelqu'un a soif, qu'il vienne à moi et qu'il boive. »
2 Samuel 7:12-16 — Contexte de l'alliance davidique.
Hébreux 13:20 — « Alliance éternelle » (thème de l'alliance de paix).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: בְּרִית שָׁלוֹם (berit shalom) — Greek (LXX): διαθήκη εἰρήνης — Aramaic: קְיָם דִּשְׁלָם
translationNotes.note: Assurance de protection durable (54:10).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: בְּלוֹא כֶסֶף… בְּלוֹא מְחִיר — Greek (LXX): ἄνευ ἀργυρίου… ἄνευ τιμῆς — Aramaic: בְּלָא כספא… בְּלָא דָמִים
translationNotes.note: Offre de provision gratuite (55:1).

translationNotes.term: La parole ne reviendra pas à vide

translationNotes.note: Garantie de la parole efficace de Dieu (55:11).

stories.keyTakeaway: Après l'oeuvre du Serviteur, Sion reçoit une alliance de paix assurée ; tous sont invités à une grâce gratuite et vivifiante, et la parole efficace de Dieu transforme.

stories.title: 🌧️ Ésaïe 55
summaryBullets: "Come, everyone who thirsts, come to the waters; and he who has no money, come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without price" (55:1).
"Why do you spend your money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which does not satisfy? Listen diligently to Me, and eat what is good, and delight yourselves in rich food" (55:2).
"Incline your ear, and come to Me; hear, that your soul may live; and I will make with you an everlasting covenant, My steadfast, sure love for David" (55:3).
Voici, j’ai fait de lui ╵un témoin pour les peuples,un chef pour commander aux peuples. (55:4).

Oui, tu appelleras ╵une nation que tu ne connais pas ;une nation qui ne te connaît pas ╵va accourir vers toi ;c’est à cause de moi, ╵moi, l’Eternel ton Dieu,moi, le Saint d’Israël,qui te couvre de gloire. (55:5).
"Seek le SEIGNEUR while He may be found; call upon Him while He is near" (55:6).
"Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to le SEIGNEUR, that He may have compassion on him, and to our God, for He will abundantly pardon" (55:7).
"For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways," declares le SEIGNEUR (55:8).
"For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are My ways higher than your ways and My thoughts than your thoughts" (55:9).

Or, la pluie et la neige ╵qui descendent du cieln’y retournent jamaissans avoir arrosé ╵et fécondé la terre,sans avoir fait germer ╵les graines qui s’y trouvent,sans fournir au semeur ╵le grain qu’il doit semer,et sans donner du pain ╵à tous ceux qui le mangent. (55:10).
"So shall My word be that goes out from My mouth; it shall not return to Me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and shall succeed in the thing for which I sent it" (55:11).
Car vous sortirez pleins de joie,vous serez conduits dans la paix.Montagnes et collineséclateront en cris de joie ╵devant vos pas.Tous les arbres des champs ╵applaudiront. (55:12).
Où croissent les broussailles ╵poussera le cyprès,et au lieu des orties ╵croîtra le myrte.Ce sera un titre de gloire ╵pour l’Eternelet un signe perpétuelqui ne disparaîtra jamais. (55:13).

stories.title: 🌍 Ésaïe 56
summaryBullets: Thus says le SEIGNEUR: "Keep justice, and do righteousness, for soon My salvation will come, and My righteousness be revealed" (56:1).
"Blessed is the man who does this, and fils de man who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath, not profaning it, and keeps his hand from doing any evil" (56:2).
Let not the foreigner who has joined himself to le SEIGNEUR say, "The LORD will surely separate me from His people"; and let not the eunuch say, "Behold, I am a dry tree" (56:3).
For thus says le SEIGNEUR: "To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, who choose the things that please Me and hold fast My covenant" (56:4).
"I will give in My house and within My walls a monument and a name better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that shall not be cut off" (56:5).

"And the foreigners who join themselves to le SEIGNEUR, to minister to Him, to love the name of le SEIGNEUR, and to be His servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath and does not profane it, and holds fast My covenant" (56:6).

"These I will bring to My holy mountain, and make them joyful in My house of prayer; their holocaustes and their sacrifices will be accepted on My altar; for My house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples" (56:7).
The Lord GOD, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, declares, "I will gather yet others to him besides those already gathered" (56:8).
Vous tous les animaux sauvages,venez, repaissez-vous,tous les animaux des forêts ! (56:9).
His watchmen are blind; they are all without knowledge; they are all silent dogs; they cannot bark, dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber (56:10).
The dogs have a mighty appetite; they never have enough. But they are shepherds who have no understanding; they have all turned to their own way, each to his own gain, one and all (56:11).
"Come," they say, "let me get wine; let us fill ourselves with strong drink; and tomorrow will be like this day, great beyond measure" (56:12).
crossRefs: Matthieu 21:13 — « Maison de prière pour toutes les nations. »
Éphésiens 2:13-19 — Ceux qui étaient loin et ceux qui étaient près amenés à la paix.
Psaumes 34:18 — L'Éternel est près de ceux qui ont le cœur brisé.

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: סָרִיס (saris) — Greek (LXX): εὐνοῦχος — Aramaic: מְהֵימַן/סריס
translationNotes.note: Auparavant exclu (Deutéronome 23:1), maintenant accueilli quand il garde l'alliance (56:3-5).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: בֵּית תְּפִלָּה — Greek (LXX): οἶκος προσευχῆς — Aramaic: בֵּית צְלוֹתָא
translationNotes.note: Rôle mondial du temple (56:7).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: דַּכָּא / שְׁפַל־רוּחַ — Greek (LXX): ταπεινός / ταπεινὸς τῷ πνεύματι — Aramaic: דַּכָּא / מִכְתַּת רוּחָא
translationNotes.note: Attitude intérieure que Dieu ranime (57:15).

stories.keyTakeaway: Dieu ouvre Sa maison aux étrangers fidèles, condamne les dirigeants corrompus et donne la paix aux humbles, mais aucune aux méchants.

stories.title: 🌍 Ésaïe 57
summaryBullets: The righteous man perishes, and no one lays it to heart; devout men are taken away, while no one understands. For the righteous man is taken away from calamity (57:1).
He enters into peace; they rest in their beds who walk in their uprightness (57:2).
Mais vous, approchez-vous,fils de ces femmes qui se livrent ╵à la divination,race adultère, prostituée ! (57:3).
Whom are you mocking? Against whom do you open your mouth wide and stick out your tongue? Are you not children of transgression, the offspring of deceit (57:4).
vous qui vous échauffez ╵auprès des chêneset sous chaque arbre vert,vous qui immolez les enfants ╵en sacrifice ╵dans les lits des torrentset les creux des rochers ? (57:5).

Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion; they, they, are your lot; to them you have poured out a libation, you have brought a offrande de céréales. Shall I relent for these things? (57:6).
On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed, and there you went up to offer sacrifice (57:7).

Behind the door and the doorpost you have set up your memorial; for, deserting Me, you have uncovered your bed, you have gone up to it, you have made it wide; and you have made a covenant for yourself with them, you have loved their bed, you have looked on nakedness (57:8).
You journeyed to the king with oil and multiplied your perfumes; you sent your envoys far off, and sent down even to Sheol (57:9).
You were wearied with the length of your way, but you did not say, "It is hopeless"; you found new life for your strength, and so you were not faint (57:10).
"Whom did you dread and fear, so that you lied, and did not remember Me, did not lay it to heart? Have I not held My peace, even for a long time, and you do not fear Me?" (57:11).
"I will declare your righteousness and your deeds, but they will not profit you" (57:12).

"When you cry out, let your collection of idols deliver you! The wind will carry them all off, a breath will take them away. But he who takes refuge in Me shall possess the land and shall inherit My holy mountain" (57:13).
And it shall be said, "Build up, build up, prepare the way, remove every obstruction from My people's way" (57:14).

Car voici ce que dit ╵le Dieu très élevéqui demeure éternellement,et qui est saint :J’habite dans un lieu ╵qui est très haut et saint,mais je demeure aussi ╵avec l’homme accablé,à l’esprit abattu,pour ranimer la vie ╵de qui a l’esprit abattuet vivifier le cœur ╵des hommes accablés. (57:15).
Car ce n’est pas toujours ╵que j’intenterai un procès,ni éternellement ╵que je m’irriterai,car sinon, devant moi, ╵le souffle de la vie ╵s’évanouirait,les êtres que j’ai faits ╵dépériraient. (57:16).
L’avidité coupable ╵du peuple d’Israëlm’avait mis en colère.Alors je l’ai frappéet je me suis caché ╵dans mon irritation.Mais lui, rebelle, ╵il a suivi la voieoù l’inclinait son cœur. (57:17).
"I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will lead him and restore comfort to him and his mourners" (57:18).
Je créerai sur leurs lèvres ╵des hymnes de louange.Paix, paix à qui est loincomme à ceux qui sont près,déclare l’Eternel.Oui, je le guérirai. (57:19).
But the wicked are like the tossing sea; for it cannot be quiet, and its waters toss up mire and dirt (57:20).
"There is no peace," says my God, "for the wicked" (57:21).
crossRefs: Matthieu 21:13 — « Maison de prière pour toutes les nations. »
Éphésiens 2:13-19 — Ceux qui étaient loin et ceux qui étaient près amenés à la paix.
Psaumes 34:18 — L'Éternel est près de ceux qui ont le cœur brisé.

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: סָרִיס (saris) — Greek (LXX): εὐνοῦχος — Aramaic: מְהֵימַן/סריס
translationNotes.note: Auparavant exclu (Deutéronome 23:1), maintenant accueilli quand il garde l'alliance (56:3-5).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: בֵּית תְּפִלָּה — Greek (LXX): οἶκος προσευχῆς — Aramaic: בֵּית צְלוֹתָא
translationNotes.note: Rôle mondial du temple (56:7).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: דַּכָּא / שְׁפַל־רוּחַ — Greek (LXX): ταπεινός / ταπεινὸς τῷ πνεύματι — Aramaic: דַּכָּא / מִכְתַּת רוּחָא
translationNotes.note: Attitude intérieure que Dieu ranime (57:15).

stories.keyTakeaway: Dieu ouvre Sa maison aux étrangers fidèles, condamne les dirigeants corrompus et donne la paix aux humbles, mais aucune aux méchants.

stories.title: 🕯️ Ésaïe 58
summaryBullets: "Cry aloud; do not hold back; lift up your voice like a trumpet; declare to My people their transgression, to the house of Jacob their sins" (58:1).

"Yet they seek Me daily and delight to know My ways, as if they were a nation that did righteousness and did not forsake the judgment of their God; they ask of Me righteous judgments; they delight to draw near to God" (58:2).

"'Why have we fasted, and You see it not? Why have we humbled ourselves, and You take no knowledge of it?' Behold, in the day of your fast you seek your own pleasure, and oppress all your workers" (58:3).
"Behold, you fast only to quarrel and to fight and to hit with a wicked fist. Fasting like yours this day will not make your voice to be heard on high" (58:4).

"Is such the fast that I choose, a day for a person to humble himself? Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? Will you call this a fast, and a day acceptable to le SEIGNEUR?" (58:5).
"Is not this the fast that I choose: to loose the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and to break every yoke?" (58:6).
"Is it not to share your bread with the hungry and bring the homeless poor into your house; when you see the naked, to cover him, and not to hide yourself from your own flesh?" (58:7).
"Then shall your light break forth like the dawn, and your healing shall spring up speedily; your righteousness shall go before you; the glory of le SEIGNEUR shall be your rear guard" (58:8).
Quand tu appelleras,l’Eternel répondra ;quand tu crieras à l’aide,il dira : « Je suis là ! » (58:9).

si tu donnes ton painà celui qui a faimet si tu pourvois aux besoins ╵de l’opprimé,la lumière luira pour toi ╵au milieu des ténèbres,et ton obscurité ╵se changera pour toi ╵en clarté de midi, (58:10).

"And le SEIGNEUR will guide you continually and satisfy your desire in scorched places and make your bones strong; and you shall be like a watered garden, like a spring of water, whose waters do not fail" (58:11).

Les tiens rebâtiront ╵les ruines d’autrefoiset tu relèveras ╵les fondements posés ╵dans les siècles passés.Tu seras appelé : ╵« Réparateur des brèches »,« le restaurateur des chemins » ╵qui rend le pays habitable. (58:12).

Si, le jour du sabbat, ╵tu te retiens de travailler,si tu t’abstiens ╵de traiter tes affaires ╵en ce jour qui m’est consacré,si pour toi le jour du sabbat ╵est un temps de délices,si ce saint jour de l’Eternel, ╵tu le tiens en estimeet si tu le respectesen t’abstenant de faire ╵ce qui te plaît,de traiter tes affaireset de tenir de longs discours, (58:13).
alors tu trouveras ╵ta joie en l’Eternel,et sur les hauteurs du pays ╵je te ferai passeret je te donnerai ╵la pleine jouissance ╵du patrimoine ╵de Jacob, ton ancêtre.L’Eternel a parlé. (58:14).
crossRefs: Matthieu 6:16-18 — Jeûner sans ostentation.
Luc 4:18 — La libération pour les opprimés (thème de la justice).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: הֲלוֹא זֶה צוֹם אֶבְחָרֵהוּ — Greek (LXX): οὐχὶ τοιοῦτος νηστεία ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην — Aramaic: הָא צֹום דְּבְחַרְתֵּיהּ
translationNotes.note: Définit le vrai jeûne comme justice et miséricorde (58:6-7).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: גֹּאֵל (goʾel) — Greek (LXX): ῥυόμενος/λυτρωτής — Aramaic: פָרִיקָא/גואל
translationNotes.note: Titre du racheteur de la famille maintenant utilisé pour l'arrivée salvatrice de Dieu (59:20).

stories.keyTakeaway: La religion vide est rejetée ; la justice et la miséricorde sont requises. Le péché humain bloque la communion, c'est pourquoi l'Éternel Lui-même intervient comme guerrier et Rédempteur.

stories.title: 🕯️ Ésaïe 59
summaryBullets: Behold, le SEIGNEUR's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save, or His ear dull, that it cannot hear (59:1).
But your iniquities have made a separation between you and your God, and your sins have hidden His face from you so that He does not hear (59:2).
For your hands are defiled with blood and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies; your tongue mutters wickedness (59:3).
No one enters suit justly; no one goes to law honestly; they rely on empty pleas, they speak lies, they conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity (59:4).
They hatch adders' eggs; they weave the spider's web; he who eats their eggs dies, and from one that is crushed a viper is hatched (59:5).
Their webs will not serve as clothing; men will not cover themselves with what they make. Their works are works of iniquity, and deeds of violence are in their hands (59:6).
Their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed innocent blood; their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; desolation and destruction are in their highways (59:7).
The way of peace they do not know, and there is no justice in their paths; they have made their roads crooked; no one who treads on them knows peace (59:8).
Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not overtake us; we hope for light, and behold, darkness, and for brightness, but we walk in gloom (59:9).

Nous allons à tâtons ╵comme des aveugles ╵le long d’un mur ;comme ceux qui n’ont plus leurs yeux,nous allons à tâtons,nous trébuchons en plein midi ╵comme à la nuit tombante ;tout en étant pleins de vigueur,nous sommes comme morts. (59:10).
We all growl like bears; we moan and moan like doves; we hope for justice, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far from us (59:11).
For our transgressions are multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and we know our iniquities (59:12).
Transgressing, and denying le SEIGNEUR, and turning back from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart lying words (59:13).
Justice is turned back, and righteousness stands far away; for truth has stumbled in the public squares, and uprightness cannot enter (59:14).
La vérité a disparuet celui qui se détourne du mal ╵se fait piller. (59:15).
Il n’a trouvé personne ╵qui intercède,il s’en est étonné.Alors son propre bras ╵lui est venu en aide,et sa justice ╵a été son soutien. (59:16).
He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on His head; He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and wrapped Himself in zeal as a cloak (59:17).
According to their deeds, so will He repay, wrath to His adversaries, repayment to His enemies; to the coastlands He will render repayment (59:18).
Ainsi, l’on craindra l’Eternel ╵et l’on révérera sa gloirede l’occident jusqu’au levant.Car il viendra ╵comme un fleuve en furieagité par un vent ╵venu de l’Eternel. (59:19).
"And a Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression," declares le SEIGNEUR (59:20).

Quant à moi, déclare l’Eternel, voici quelle est l’alliance que je fais avec eux : Mon Esprit qui repose sur toi et mes paroles que je mets dans ta bouche, ne s’écarteront ni de ta bouche, ni de la bouche de tes enfants, ni de la bouche de leurs enfants. Voilà ce que dit l’Eternel, dès maintenant et pour l’éternité. (59:21).

stories.title: 🌅 Ésaïe 60
summaryBullets: "Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of le SEIGNEUR has risen upon you" (60:1).
"For behold, darkness shall cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but le SEIGNEUR will arise upon you, and His glory will be seen upon you" (60:2).
"And nations shall come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising" (60:3).
"Lift up your eyes all around, and see; they all gather together, they come to you; your sons shall come from afar, and your daughters shall be carried on the hip" (60:4).

Tu le verras alors, ╵tu brilleras de joie,ton cœur tressaillira ╵et se dilateracar, les richesses que transportent ╵les vaisseaux sillonnant la mer ╵seront dirigées vers tes ports.Les trésors des nations ╵arriveront chez toi. (60:5).

"A multitude of camels shall cover you, the young camels of Midian and Ephah; all those from Sheba shall come. They shall bring gold and frankincense, and shall bring good news, the praises of le SEIGNEUR" (60:6).
"All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth shall minister to you; they shall come up with acceptance on My altar, and I will beautify My beautiful house" (60:7).
"Who are these that fly like a cloud, and like doves to their windows?" (60:8).

Les habitants des îles ╵et des régions côtières ╵mettront leur espérance en moi,les vaisseaux au long cours ╵viendront les tout premierspour ramener tes fils de loinavec leur argent et leur orpour faire honneur ╵à l’Eternel, ton Dieu,et au Saint d’Israël ╵qui te fait resplendir. (60:9).
"Foreigners shall build up your walls, and their kings shall minister to you; for in My wrath I struck you, but in My favor I have had mercy on you" (60:10).
Tes portes, jour et nuit, ╵seront toujours ouvertes,on ne les fermera jamaispour laisser affluer vers toiles trésors des nations,et leurs rois en cortège. (60:11).
Car la nation ou le royaumequi ne te seront pas assujettis ╵disparaîtront ;oui, en effet ces nations-là ╵seront complètement ruinées. (60:12).
"The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress, the plane, and the pine, to beautify the place of My sanctuary, and I will make the place of My feet glorious" (60:13).

Les descendants de ceux ╵qui t’humiliaientviendront se courber devant toi,et ceux qui t’insultaientse prosterneront à tes pieds.Et l’on t’appellera : ╵« Cité de l’Eternel,la Sion du Saint d’Israël ». (60:14).
"Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, with no one passing through, I will make you majestic forever, a joy from age to age" (60:15).
Tu téteras le lait au seindes nations et des roiset tu sauras que je suis l’Eternel, ╵que c’est moi qui te sauve,que je suis ton libérateur, ╵le Puissant de Jacob. (60:16).

"Instead of bronze I will bring gold, and instead of iron I will bring silver; instead of wood, bronze, instead of stones, iron. I will make your overseers peace and your taskmasters righteousness" (60:17).
"Violence shall no more be heard in your land, devastation or destruction within your borders; you shall call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise" (60:18).
"The sun shall be no more your light by day, nor for brightness shall the moon give you light; but le SEIGNEUR will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory" (60:19).
"Your sun shall no more go down, nor your moon withdraw itself; for le SEIGNEUR will be your everlasting light, and your days of mourning shall be ended" (60:20).
"Your people shall all be righteous; they shall possess the land forever, the branch of My planting, the work of My hands, that I might be glorified" (60:21).
"The least one shall become a clan, and the smallest one a mighty nation; Je suis le SEIGNEUR; in its time I will hasten it" (60:22).
crossRefs: Matthieu 5:14 — Ville sur une colline et lumière du monde.
Luc 4:16-21 — Jésus lit Ésaïe 61:1-2.
Apocalypse 21:23-26 — Les nations marchent à la lumière de la ville.

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: קוּמִי אוֹרִי (qūmī ʾorī) — Greek (LXX): φῶς φώτισαι — Aramaic: קוּמִי אֲנְהָרִי
translationNotes.note: Appel à manifester la gloire donnée par Dieu (60:1).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: מָשַׁח (mashach) / רוּחַ אֲדֹנָי — Greek (LXX): ἔχρισέν με / πνεῦμα Κυρίου — Aramaic: מְשַׁח יָתִי / רוּחַ יוי
translationNotes.note: Autorisation pour la proclamation de la bonne nouvelle (61:1).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: חֶפְצִי־בָהּ (‘My Delight Is in Her’) / בְּעוּלָה (‘Married’) — Greek (LXX): Θελητή / Γαμητή — Aramaic: חֵפְצִי בַּהּ / תְּבוּלָא
translationNotes.note: Noms signalant le plaisir de Dieu et le lien rétabli (62:4).

stories.keyTakeaway: La lumière de Sion attire les nations ; le héraut oint par l'Esprit annonce la liberté ; Dieu se plaît en Sion et lui donne un nouveau nom d'épousée.

stories.title: 🌅 Ésaïe 61
summaryBullets: L’Esprit de l’Eternel, ╵du Seigneur, est sur moi (61:1).
"To proclaim the year of le SEIGNEUR's favor, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all who mourn" (61:2).

"To grant to those who mourn in Zion—to give them a beautiful headdress instead of ashes, the oil of gladness instead of mourning, the garment of praise instead of a faint spirit; that they may be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of le SEIGNEUR, that He may be glorified" (61:3).
They shall build up the ancient ruins; they shall raise up the former devastations; they shall repair the ruined cities, the devastations of many generations (61:4).
Strangers shall stand and tend your flocks; foreigners shall be your plowmen and vinedressers (61:5).

Mais vous, on vous appellera ╵« Prêtres de l’Eternel » ;on dira que vous êtes ╵servants de notre Dieu.Vous jouirez ╵des trésors des nationset vous mettrez votre fierté ╵dans ce qui fait leur gloire. (61:6).

Instead of your shame there shall be a double portion; instead of dishonor they shall rejoice in their lot; therefore in their land they shall possess a double portion; they shall have everlasting joy (61:7).
For I le SEIGNEUR love justice; I hate robbery and wrong; I will faithfully give them their recompense, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them (61:8).
Leurs descendants seront connus ╵chez les nations,et leur progéniture ╵parmi les peuples.Tous ceux qui les verront ╵reconnaîtront en euxune postérité ╵bénie par l’Eternel. (61:9).

Je serai plein de joie, ╵l’Eternel en sera la source.J’exulterai ╵à cause de mon Dieu,parce qu’il m’aura revêtu ╵des habits du salutet qu’il m’aura enveloppé ╵du manteau de justice,tout comme le marié ╵se pare d’un turban ╵tout comme un prêtre,et comme la mariée ╵s’orne de ses bijoux. (61:10).
For as the earth brings forth its sprouts, and as a garden causes what is sown in it to sprout up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to sprout up before all the nations (61:11).
