stories.title: 🌅 Ésaïe 62
summaryBullets: For Zion's sake I will not keep silent, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not be quiet, until her righteousness goes forth as brightness, and her salvation as a burning torch (62:1).
The nations shall see your righteousness, and all the kings your glory, and you shall be called by a new name that the mouth of le SEIGNEUR will give (62:2).
Tu seras dans la main de l’Eternelune couronne, ╵rayonnant de splendeuret un turban royaldans la main de ton Dieu. (62:3).

Tu ne seras plus appelée ╵« La Délaissée »,et ton pays ne sera plus nommé ╵« La terre dévastée »,mais on t’appellera ╵« En elle est mon plaisir ».Et ton pays sera nommé ╵« La terre qui est épousée »parce que l’Eternel ╵prendra plaisir en toi,car ton pays ╵sera pour lui ╵comme une épouse. (62:4).
For as a young man marries a young woman, so shall your sons marry you, and as the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, so shall your God rejoice over you (62:5).
On your walls, O Jerusalem, I have set watchmen; all the day and all the night they shall never be silent. You who put le SEIGNEUR in remembrance, take no rest (62:6).
And give Him no rest until He establishes Jerusalem and makes it a praise in the earth (62:7).
The LORD has sworn by His right hand and by His mighty arm: "I will not again give your grain to be food for your enemies, and foreigners shall not drink your wine for which you have labored" (62:8).
But those who garner it shall eat it and praise le SEIGNEUR, and those who gather it shall drink it in the courts of My sanctuary (62:9).
Go through, go through the gates; prepare the way for the people; build up, build up the highway; clear it of stones; lift up a signal over the peoples (62:10).
L’Eternel se fera entendrejusqu’aux confins du monde :Dites à la communauté de Sion :Ton salut va venir,avec lui, son salaire,et devant lui sa récompense. (62:11).
On les appellera ╵« Le Peuple saint,les libérés de l’Eternel ».Et toi, Jérusalem, ╵tu seras nommée « Désirée »,« La ville qui n’est pas abandonnée ». (62:12).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: מָשַׁח (mashach) / רוּחַ אֲדֹנָי — Greek (LXX): ἔχρισέν με / πνεῦμα Κυρίου — Aramaic: מְשַׁח יָתִי / רוּחַ יוי
translationNotes.note: Autorisation pour la proclamation de la bonne nouvelle (61:1).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: חֶפְצִי־בָהּ (‘My Delight Is in Her’) / בְּעוּלָה (‘Married’) — Greek (LXX): Θελητή / Γαμητή — Aramaic: חֵפְצִי בַּהּ / תְּבוּלָא
translationNotes.note: Noms signalant le plaisir de Dieu et le lien rétabli (62:4).

stories.keyTakeaway: La lumière de Sion attire les nations ; le héraut oint par l'Esprit annonce la liberté ; Dieu se plaît en Sion et lui donne un nouveau nom d'épousée.

stories.title: 🩸 Ésaïe 63
summaryBullets: "Who is this who comes from Edom, in crimsoned garments from Bozrah, He who is splendid in His apparel, marching in the greatness of His strength?" "It is I, speaking in righteousness, mighty to save" (63:1).
"Why is Your apparel red, and Your garments like his who treads in the winepress?" (63:2).

"I have trodden the winepress alone, and from the peoples no one was with Me; I trod them in My anger and trampled them in My wrath; their lifeblood spattered on My garments, and stained all My apparel" (63:3).
"For the day of vengeance was in My heart, and My year of redemption had come" (63:4).

J’ai regardé partout :personne pour m’aider !Je me suis étonné :n’y a-t-il donc personne ╵pour me prêter main-forte ?Mais mon bras a fait œuvre de salut pour moi,et mon indignation ╵a été mon soutien. (63:5).
"I trampled down the peoples in My anger; I made them drunk in My wrath, and I poured out their lifeblood on the earth" (63:6).

Je rappellerai les actes de bienveillance ╵de l’Eternelet les motifs de le louer :il a tout fait pour nous.Je dirai les nombreux bienfaits ╵dont il a comblé Israël,le bien qu’il leur a faitdans sa tendresseet sa grande bonté. (63:7).
For He said, "Surely they are My people, children who will not deal falsely." And He became their Savior (63:8).

Dans toutes leurs détresses,il a été lui-même ╵dans la détresse,et l’ange qui se tient en sa présence ╵les a sauvés.Dans son amour ╵et dans sa compassion,il les a libérés,il les a soutenus ╵et il les a portéstous les jours d’autrefois. (63:9).
But they rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit; therefore He turned to be their enemy, and Himself fought against them (63:10).

Alors ils se sont souvenus ╵des temps anciens ╵et de Moïse, et de son peupleet ils ont dit : ╵« Où est celui ╵qui les a fait sortirde la mer avec le berger ╵de son troupeau ?Et où est celui qui a mis ╵son Esprit Saint au milieu d’eux, (63:11).
Who caused His glorious arm to go at the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to make for Himself an everlasting name (63:12).
Who led them through the depths? Like a horse in the desert, they did not stumble (63:13).
Like livestock that go down into the valley, the Spirit of le SEIGNEUR gave them rest. So You led Your people, to make for Yourself a glorious name (63:14).
Look down from heaven and see, from Your holy and beautiful habitation. Where are Your zeal and Your might? The stirring of Your inner parts and Your compassion are held back from me (63:15).
For You are our Father, though Abraham does not know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us; You, O LORD, are our Father, our Redeemer from of old is Your name (63:16).
O LORD, why do You make us wander from Your ways and harden our heart, so that we fear You not? Return for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your heritage (63:17).
Your holy people held possession for a little while; our adversaries have trampled down Your sanctuary (63:18).
We have become like those over whom You have never ruled, like those who are not called by Your name (63:19).
crossRefs: Apocalypse 19:13-15 — Vêtement trempé dans le sang, foulant le pressoir.
Exode 34:6-7 — Le caractère d'amour fidèle rappelé.
Romains 9:20-21 — Métaphore du potier et de l'argile.

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: פוּרָה / גַּת (purah/gat) — Greek (LXX): ληνός — Aramaic: מַעְצְרָא
translationNotes.note: Imagerie d'écrasement pour le jugement (63:2-3).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: בֶּגֶד עִדִּים (beged ʿiddim) — Greek (LXX): ῥάκος ἀποκαθημένης — Aramaic: לְבוּשׁ מְסוּא
translationNotes.note: Image forte d'impureté rituelle pour la justice humaine (64:6).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: קָרַעְתָּ שָׁמַיִם (qaraʿta shamayim) — Greek (LXX): διέρρηξας οὐρανούς — Aramaic: קְרַע שְׁמַיָּא
translationNotes.note: Prière pour une intervention visible et bouleversante (64:1).

stories.keyTakeaway: Dieu apparaît comme un juge aux vêtements ensanglantés, tandis que la communauté se souvient de Sa miséricorde et Le supplie de descendre, confessant le péché et demandant à un Père de refaçonner Son peuple.

stories.title: 🩸 Ésaïe 64
summaryBullets: Oh that You would rend the heavens and come down, that the mountains might quake at Your presence (64:1).
As when fire kindles brushwood and the fire causes water to boil—to make Your name known to Your adversaries, and that the nations might tremble at Your presence! (64:2).
When You did awesome things that we did not look for, You came down, the mountains quaked at Your presence (64:3).
From of old no one has heard or perceived by the ear, no eye has seen a God besides You, who acts for those who wait for Him (64:4).
You meet him who joyfully works righteousness, those who remember You in Your ways. Behold, You were angry, and we sinned; in our sins we have been a long time, and shall we be saved? (64:5).
We have all become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous deeds are like a polluted garment. We all fade like a leaf, and our iniquities, like the wind, take us away (64:6).
There is no one who calls upon Your name, who rouses himself to take hold of You; for You have hidden Your face from us, and have made us melt in the hand of our iniquities (64:7).
But now, O LORD, You are our Father; we are the clay, and You are our potter; we are all the work of Your hand (64:8).
Be not so terribly angry, O LORD, and remember not iniquity forever. Behold, please look, we are all Your people (64:9).
Your holy cities have become a wilderness; Zion has become a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation (64:10).
Our holy and beautiful house, where our fathers praised You, has been burned by fire, and all our pleasant places have become ruins (64:11).
Will You restrain Yourself at these things, O LORD? Will You keep silent, and afflict us so terribly? (64:12).

stories.title: 🌍 Ésaïe 65
summaryBullets: "I was ready to be sought by those who did not ask for Me; I was ready to be found by those who did not seek Me. I said, 'Here I am, here I am,' to a nation that was not called by My name" (65:1).
"I spread out My hands all the day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, following their own devices" (65:2).
"A people who provoke Me to My face continually, sacrificing in gardens and making offerings on bricks" (65:3).
"Who sit in tombs, and spend the night in secret places; who eat pig's flesh, and broth of tainted meat is in their vessels" (65:4).
"Who say, 'Keep to yourself, do not come near me, for I am too holy for you.' These are a smoke in My nostrils, a fire that burns all the day" (65:5).
"Behold, it is written before Me: 'I will not keep silent, but I will repay; I will indeed repay into their lap'" (65:6).

"Both your iniquities and your fathers' iniquities together," says le SEIGNEUR; "because they made offerings on the mountains and insulted Me on the hills, I will measure into their lap payment for their former deeds" (65:7).

Thus says le SEIGNEUR: "As the new wine is found in the cluster, and they say, 'Do not destroy it, for there is a blessing in it,' so I will do for My servants' sake, and not destroy them all" (65:8).
"I will bring forth offspring from Jacob, and from Judah possessors of My mountains; My chosen shall possess it, and My servants shall dwell there" (65:9).
"Sharon shall become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down, for My people who have sought Me" (65:10).
"But you who forsake le SEIGNEUR, who forget My holy mountain, who set a table for Fortune and fill cups of mixed wine for Destiny" (65:11).

je vous destine au glaive,et vous vous courberez ╵pour passer tous à l’abattoir,puisque j’ai appeléet que vous ne m’avez pas répondu,et puisque j’ai parléet que vous ne m’avez pas écouté,puisque vous avez fait ╵ce que je trouve mal,et que vous vous êtes complu ╵dans ce qui me déplaît. (65:12).

C’est pourquoi, voici ce que dit ╵le Seigneur, l’Eternel :Mes serviteurs ╵auront de quoi manger,et vous, vous aurez faim.Mes serviteurs boiront,et vous, vous aurez soif.Mes serviteurs ╵seront dans l’allégresse,et vous, vous serez dans la honte ! (65:13).
"Behold, My servants shall sing for gladness of heart, but you shall cry out for pain of heart and shall wail for breaking of spirit" (65:14).
Votre nom restera ╵dans les imprécations ╵de mes élus ;le Seigneur, l’Eternel, ╵fera que vous mouriez,mais à ses serviteurs ╵il donnera un nom nouveau. (65:15).
Et celui qui voudra ╵être béni sur terreinvoquera sur lui ╵une bénédiction ╵au nom du Dieu de vérité,et sur la terre, ╵qui prêtera serment ╵jurera par le Dieu de vérité. (65:16).
"For behold, I create new heavens and a new earth, and the former things shall not be remembered or come into mind" (65:17).
"But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for behold, I create Jerusalem to be a joy, and her people to be a gladness" (65:18).
J’exulterai moi-même ╵à cause de Jérusalemet je me réjouirai ╵au sujet de mon peuple. (65:19).

Là, plus de nourrissonemporté en bas âge,ni de vieillard qui meure ╵avant d’avoir atteint ╵le nombre de ses ans.Ce sera mourir jeune ╵de mourir centenaire ;si un pécheur ╵ne dépasse pas les cent ans, ╵c’est qu’il aura été maudit. (65:20).
"They shall build houses and inhabit them; they shall plant vineyards and eat their fruit" (65:21).

"They shall not build and another inhabit; they shall not plant and another eat; for like the days of a tree shall the days of My people be, and My chosen shall long enjoy the work of their hands" (65:22).

Ils ne peineront plus pour rienet les enfants ╵auxquels ils donneront naissance ╵ne seront plus destinés au malheur.Ils seront une race ╵bénie par l’Eternel,et leur postérité ╵le sera avec eux. (65:23).
"Before they call I will answer; while they are yet speaking I will hear" (65:24).

Les loups et les agneaux ╵paîtront ensemble,le lion mangera du fourrage ╵tout comme le bétail ;le serpent mordra la poussière.Il ne se fera plus ╵ni mal, ni destruction,sur toute ma montagne sainte,dit l’Eternel ! (65:25).
crossRefs: Apocalypse 21:1-4 — Nouveau ciel et nouvelle terre.
Romains 10:20 — « J'ai été trouvé par ceux qui ne me cherchaient pas. »
Marc 9:48 — « Leur ver ne meurt point et le feu ne s'éteint point. »

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: בּוֹרֵא (boreʾ) — Greek (LXX): κτίζω — Aramaic: בָּרֵא
translationNotes.note: Le même verbe de création utilisé pour l'œuvre originelle de Dieu (65:17).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: שָׁחָה (shachah)
translationNotes.note: Se prosterner ou s'incliner en humilité. Utilisé pour la révérence envers Dieu (Genèse 22:5 ; Exode 4:31 ; Psaumes 95:6 ; Ésaïe 66:23) mais aussi pour les rois ou les anges. Très physique et centré sur la posture.

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: נֶכֶה־רוּחַ / חָרֵד עַל דְּבָרִי — Greek (LXX): ταπεινὸς τῷ πνεύματι / τρέμων τοὺς λόγους — Aramaic: מְכִיךְ רוּחָא / דְּחֵיל מִן פִּתְגָמִי
translationNotes.note: L'attitude d'adoration choisie par Dieu (66:2-5).

translationNotes.original: Hebrew: תּוֹלָעָתָם לֹא תָמוּת… אֵשָׁם לֹא תִכְבֶּה — Greek (LXX): ὁ σκώληξ οὐ τελευτᾷ… τὸ πῦρ οὐ σβέννυται — Aramaic: תַּלְעָא לָא מֵית… נוּרָא לָא דָעֵךְ
translationNotes.note: Signe sans fin du jugement contre la rébellion persistante (66:24).

stories.keyTakeaway: Dieu crée un monde renouvelé pour Ses serviteurs humbles, rejette la fausse religion, rassemble des adorateurs de toutes les nations et laisse un signe éternel contre la rébellion.

stories.title: 🌍 Ésaïe 66
summaryBullets: Voici ce que dit l’Eternel : (66:1).

"All these things My hand has made, and so all these things came to be," declares le SEIGNEUR. "But this is the one to whom I will look: he who is humble and contrite in spirit and trembles at My word" (66:2).

"He who slaughters an ox is like one who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, like one who breaks a dog's neck; he who presents a offrande de céréales, like one who offers pig's blood; he who makes a memorial offering of frankincense, like one who blesses an idol. These have chosen their own ways, and their soul delights in their abominations" (66:3).

"I also will choose harsh treatment for them and bring their fears upon them, because when I called, no one answered, when I spoke, they did not listen; but they did what was evil in My eyes and chose that in which I did not delight" (66:4).

Ecoutez la parole ╵de l’Eternel,vous qui tremblez à sa parole :Voici, ceux de vos frèresqui vous haïssent ╵et vous ont rejetésà cause de mon nomont dit : « Que l’Eternel ╵manifeste sa gloireafin que nous soyons ╵témoins de votre joie ! »Mais ils perdront la face ! (66:5).
Ecoutez ce tumulte ╵s’élevant de la ville,cette clameur ╵venant du Temple :il s’agit de la voix de l’Eternelqui fait payer ses ennemis ╵comme ils l’ont mérité. (66:6).
"Before she was in labor she gave birth; before her pain came upon her she delivered a son" (66:7).

"Who has heard such a thing? Who has seen such things? Shall a land be born in one day? Shall a nation be brought forth in one moment? For as soon as Zion was in labor she brought forth her children" (66:8).
"Shall I bring to the point of birth and not cause to bring forth?" says le SEIGNEUR; "shall I, who cause to bring forth, shut the womb?" says your God (66:9).
"Rejoice with Jerusalem, and be glad for her, all you who love her; rejoice with her in joy, all you who mourn over her" (66:10).
"That you may nurse and be satisfied from her consoling breast; that you may drink deeply with delight from her glorious abundance" (66:11).

Car ainsi parle l’Eternel :Je vais faire affluer la paix ╵vers elle comme un fleuve,la gloire des nations ╵tout comme un torrent qui déborde.Vous serez allaités,et portés sur la hanche,bercés sur les genoux. (66:12).
"As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you; you shall be comforted in Jerusalem" (66:13).
Vous en serez témoins ╵et votre cœur se réjouira,votre corps reprendra vigueur ╵tout comme une herbe qui verdit. (66:14).
"For behold, le SEIGNEUR will come in fire, and His chariots like the whirlwind, to render His anger in fury, and His rebuke with flames of fire" (66:15).
"For by fire will le SEIGNEUR enter into judgment, and by His sword, with all flesh; and those slain by le SEIGNEUR shall be many" (66:16).

Ceux qui se préparent et qui se purifient pour accéder aux jardins sacrés suivant en procession celui qui se tient au milieu, et qui mangent du porc, des animaux immondes et même des souris, ceux-là périront tous ensemble, l’Eternel le déclare. (66:17).
"For I know their works and their thoughts, and the time is coming to gather all nations and tongues. And they shall come and shall see My glory" (66:18).

Je placerai un signe au milieu d’eux et j’enverrai certains de leurs rescapés vers d’autres peuples, à Tarsis, Poul et Loud, dont les gens bandent l’arc, à Toubal, à Yavân ; vers les îles et les régions côtières qui sont au loin, qui n’ont pas encore entendu parler de moi et n’ont pas vu ma gloire. Ils feront connaître ma gloire à ces peuples. (66:19).

"And they shall bring all your brothers from all the nations as an offering to le SEIGNEUR, on horses and in chariots and in litters and on mules and on dromedaries, to My holy mountain Jerusalem," says le SEIGNEUR, "just as the Israelites bring their offrande de céréales in a clean vessel to the house of le SEIGNEUR" (66:20).
"And some of them also I will take for priests and for Levites," says le SEIGNEUR (66:21).
"For as the new heavens and the new earth that I make shall remain before Me," says le SEIGNEUR, "so shall your offspring and your name remain" (66:22).
"From new moon to new moon, and from Sabbath to Sabbath, all flesh shall come to worship before Me," declares le SEIGNEUR (66:23).

Et quand ils sortiront, ils verront les cadavres des hommes qui se sont révoltés contre moi ; et le ver qui rongera ces hommes ne mourra pas, le feu qui les dévorera ne s’éteindra jamais, et ils feront horreur à tout être vivant. (66:24).
